title: Steamed Kasha Pilaf
description: A simple yet flavorful French-inspired side dish made with kasha and steamy vegetables.
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a medium saucepan.
Add kasha and cook according to package instructions.
Add pilaf to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add steamy vegetables to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and cover the saucepan with a lid.
Simmer for 20 minutes or until the kasha and pilaf are tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork to separate the grains.
